description: This file defines the CatalogViewModelService class, a UI-specific service responsible for retrieving and constructing catalog view models, including fetching catalog items, brands, and types, and preparing data for display in the web UI.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to generate catalog view models for UI display, including fetching catalog items, brands, and types with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a paginated list of catalog items filtered by brand and type, constructs and returns a CatalogIndexViewModel containing items, filter options, and pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all brands from the repository, converts them into a list of SelectListItem for UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all catalog types from the repository, converts them into a list of SelectListItem for UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.
